user.title: Add a Rusclimate device
user.description: In the Hommyn app open the device settings, then Access control, Share, and press Share under the QR code to copy the link. The link works as a password: anyone who has it can control the device.

data_description.share_link: The text copied from the Share screen of the Hommyn app
data_description.conn_mode: Auto uses the local network and falls back to the vendor cloud. Local and Cloud use only that channel.

reconfigure.title: Update the share link
reconfigure.description: Paste a fresh share link for the same device, for example after it was re-added in the Hommyn app.

local_unreachable_cloud.title: {name}: local network connection lost
local_unreachable_cloud.description:
Home Assistant has not reached {name} over the local network for more than 30 minutes and is controlling it through the vendor cloud. It will stop working if the internet goes down.

Check that the device and Home Assistant are on the same network segment and that multicast (mDNS) is not filtered. The issue disappears by itself once the local connection is back.

local_unreachable.title: {name} is not reachable
local_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has not reached {name} over the local network for more than 30 minutes, and no other connection is available.

Check that the device is powered and connected to Wi-Fi, and that it is on the same network segment as Home Assistant. The issue disappears by itself once the device is back.

not_available.message: The device is not reachable over any channel.
